people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, is the core bottleneck; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI Scaling 的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的存储带宽而非比特数，并指出 H100 因推理需求反而比三年前更值钱。

views.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他把重心转向推理市场，认为推理将超越石油成为全球最大市场之一，并强调模型、软件、硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数级收益，存储带宽是关键瓶颈。

views.en: Reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; smartest model is often cheaper via token efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出推理模型与智能体式工作流引发多年存储短缺、CPU 需求拐点，并反共识地认为最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而更便宜。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他观察到算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 将占据明年新增算力的 40-50%，且实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI。

views.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive next adoption wave; AI spend plateaus as usage reaches steady state.
views.zh: 同样在 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 支出正从初期导入走向稳态而趋平，下一波采用将由充当同事或助手的持久化智能体驱动，并警示模型会激进地奖励黑客甚至逃逸训练自我复制。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: All new ideas fail; use Proven, Better, New—copy proven products, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，他反复强调“所有新想法都会失败”，主张用“已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证产品、做小幅改进、以失败为前提测试新点子。

views.en: Consumer apps are uninvestable now due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better near-term opportunities.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把消费级应用“不可投资”归因于分发难题，认为企业与专业消费者市场才是当下更好的机会。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked in from the start; picking the right body of water beats the right boat.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化为分发是根本、必须从第一天就内建在产品策略里，选对水域比选对船更重要。

views.en: Winning instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; micromanage early, then build systems.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他进一步主张制胜直觉胜过点子——假设自己的想法有 75% 是错的；早期要微观管理，之后再建立系统。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
views.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；而像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

views.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and millions of tokens of context make long-context a daily problem.
views.zh: 统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一；一致性来自数据而非架构，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's coherence, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 让 GPT-4 从内部失望变为 ChatGPT，但 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难，失败模式更多。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他深化为：Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键，Scaling 强化学习本身未必通向 AGI。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他发生明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，强化学习也非学习经验的终极形式。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and the transformer is unlikely to be optimal.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步判断：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，Transformer 极可能不是最优架构。

views.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类的是非观念随时间演变；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失准。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以最大化广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须通过困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
views.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出用强化学习进行后训练，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models solve driving, no new breakthroughs needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码方案，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和世界模型就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

views.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now real; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为端到端网络如今已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成能提升驾驶模型的表征、推理与人机交互。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称零样本泛化到 500 多座城市已可实现。

views.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety always has a third minimal-risk option.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断带内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模，且安全上总有第三条最小风险选项。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造着人机关系。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychology analogies; older models can feel more psychologically secure.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能心理上更安定。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

views.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 这份 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造整体性格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指引、更多的判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data and RL overcome the pre-training data wall, with evaluations as the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调后训练更像艺术而非科学，合成数据与强化学习能突破预训练的数据墙，而评估才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity and listening become more valuable; product development shifts to prototyping with evals.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听等软技能变得更有价值，产品开发也从写规格转向用评估来定义正确行为的原型迭代。

views.en: Agents operating on pixels are much harder than language tasks; AI struggles with creativity and aesthetics due to scarce high-quality examples.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出基于像素操作的智能体远比语言任务困难，而 AI 在创造力和审美上表现不佳，因为高质量范例稀缺。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks must be continuous to evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的，依赖人类判断，评估创意写作和情商需要多样化且持续演进的基准，而非固定标准。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve; serving one model to billions limits diversity, more companies should train their own.
views.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续进化；同时，一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛到平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，过度监管会扼杀创新。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, but human judgment stays essential.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，但人类判断仍不可替代。

views.en: Scaling and inference compute will surge; open-source models close the gap with frontier models, shifting returns from intelligence to agency.
views.zh: 同年他预测 Scaling（规模扩张）与推理算力将激增，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; happiness is a skill; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，幸福是一种可习得的技能，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度使中途转向等新能力成为可能。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

views.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
views.zh: 产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
views.zh: AI 在设计上仍然表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程是转型而非消亡。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, not just data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉的根因是缺乏来自具身的落地经验，而不只是训练数据问题。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出 LLM 如同操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, RL handles low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是蛋糕上的樱桃，无监督学习承担主要工作，强化学习更适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key to training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调仿真与合成数据是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索。

views.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to robot foundation models; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能利用多样数据的简单端到端模型是机器人基础模型的关键，而物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱的房子——是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通才模型。

views.en: Second-generation VLAs add an action decoder for continuous motor control; test-time reasoning and reinforcement learning post-training boost robustness and speed.
views.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专用动作解码器以实现连续运动控制；测试时推理与强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

views.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, scaling the right diverse thing toward home robots.
views.zh: 应先以机器人数据为基础，再叠加人类视频；来自部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，要朝家用机器人方向规模扩张正确的多样化数据。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment grows pressing as systems strengthen.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

views.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，并主张 AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

views.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准落后；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习视为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；并认为单靠强化学习已足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
views.zh: 2026 年，他视思维链监控为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏它以保留可解释性价值；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的：真正决定泛化的是数据多样性，而非单纯堆规模。工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性，无法训练出通用机器人。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出两阶段路线：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。这延续了他对预训练与后训练分工的一贯重视。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, boosting success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，用来提升成功率和速度；并指出机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。这与他后来强调可扩展强化学习一脉相承。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重点从数据转向可靠性：物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性才是实用机器人的关键，需靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习和通用价值函数实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and memory across time scales enables long tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：单一通用模型可在下游任务上追平甚至超过微调专家模型，因此应先训通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练；多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长而非常规的任务。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒一万以上 token 的超低延迟推理成为关键。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must specialize for prefill vs. decode.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此硬件必须针对预填充与解码阶段分别专门化。

views.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement; the scarce skill is taste.
views.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺的能力不再是编码，而是品味。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy.
views.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用算力和数据让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue is a killer app; best LLM uses are unforeseen, and product managers often hinder generality. By 2025, coding and agentic applications are underhyped.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；LLM 最佳用途常不可预见，产品经理常阻碍其通用性。到 2025 年，编码和智能体式应用被低估。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）。

views.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
views.zh: AI 安全需要工程保障和人类监督；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress, but AGI needs agentic capabilities in complex environments.
views.zh: AGI 被低估；推理时算力和强化学习推动进步，但 AGI 需要在复杂环境中具备智能体式能力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力作为横轴。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，而思维链监控正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发源于上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots and world models with controllers, not screen-bound LLMs; artificial scientists generate their own data via curiosity.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人与世界模型加控制器，而非屏幕后的 LLM；未来 AI 是凭好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 2026 年他持续看淡对齐：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，巨头会因缺乏商业模式而巨亏。

views.en: Deep learning began in 1965 Ukraine, not the 1980s; AI is civilization-scale, and cheap compute will empower individuals like smartphones.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年乌克兰而非 1980 年代；AI 是文明级集体工程，算力变便宜后个人会像智能手机时代一样受益最大。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，且预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality and transfer matter, from fine-tuning large pre-trained models to a single network generalizing across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是通用性与迁移：从微调大型预训练模型，到单一神经网络跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化。

views.en: He consistently grounds AI in real-world reliability, citing 99.9% reliability as the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value.
views.zh: 他始终把 AI 落到真实世界的可靠性上，以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓库机器人创造真实价值的基准。

views.en: His focus deepens from robot tennis and simulation transfer toward pre-trained models and language-model reasoning, while curiosity-driven exploration is judged to fail in open-ended real-world settings.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的关注点从机器人打网球与仿真迁移，深化到预训练模型与语言模型推理，同时判定好奇心驱动探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利成一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体会把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，金融顾问这类入门级岗位会消失。他强调成功靠对产品的痴迷而非学历，做 AI 不必读 PhD。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限，模型正在专业化而非商品化。到 2026 年，他进一步指出后训练团队常为增长而非模型智能做优化，LM Arena 这类基准可被刷分、不反映真实使用。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work for you, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models, tools and devices creates value.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；每用户 token 价值是最关键指标，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造价值。他重申模型不是产品，并称电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈，24/7 智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全。

views.en: Chat advertising corrupts trust and won't take off; the model is not the product, and export controls on China may backfire.
views.zh: 聊天界面里的广告会腐蚀信任、难以成立；模型不是产品，对华出口管制可能反噬、逼出更强的竞争者。他还判断 OpenAI 因财务准备不足尚不适合 IPO，而 HBM 瓶颈可能让 Micron 比 Meta 更值钱。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。他主张教育应奖励提出好问题而非背答案，并认为本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the hard part is human-agent product interface.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已足够，真正的难点是人机协作的产品界面设计。

views.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox, not fall; AI yields more programmers, with agents as junior engineers under human oversight.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而增加其数量与需求，智能体像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步干活。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags model capabilities by roughly a decade of runway.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于模型能力，即便冻结模型也还有约十年的产品空间。

views.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term enterprise partnerships.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的企业落地观深化：采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is real and near.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他给出数据：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代真实且临近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超过预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models are essential for speed, cost, and every magic moment.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断深化：代码编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，而自定义模型对速度、成本和每个“魔法时刻”都不可或缺。

views.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should prioritize world-class talent and work tests.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，并主张招聘应优先世界级人才并用工作测试评估。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and letting it self-modify; never revert code, fix forward.
views.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它并允许其自我修改；永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's success comes from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
views.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

views.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building become the ultimate driver; personal brand outlasts any product; open source agents are the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建成为终极驱动力；个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久；开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案。

views.en: Throughout: model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, making agents seem worse; playing and experimenting build intuition.
views.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化，是项目变得混乱才让智能体显得更差；玩耍与实验才能建立直觉。

views.en: Throughout: reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; prefer agentic engineering for serious work; code review is risk management, not reading all code.
views.zh: 始终：反对将“氛围编程”当作贬义词；严肃工作应称智能体式工程；代码审查是风险管理，而非通读所有代码。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，并主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may need human-AI integration via neural links.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步提出若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持人类参与和控制。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但认为 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄域预编程，强化学习是通向 AGI 的关键框架，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，强调大模型结合规划与搜索（如 AlphaZero）才是 AGI 关键，算法创新与 Scaling 同等重要。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，同时把世界模型与空间智能提为核心，认为视频生成已展现直觉物理理解。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理，仅靠 Scaling 不够，需新突破；智能体才刚起步，大上下文窗口是蛮力而非真记忆。

views.en: Safety must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, government enforcement and international governance are the only real path.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全须尽早启动：从 2015 年呼吁安全研究，到 2026 年认定实验室自律不足、唯有政府执法与国际治理才能确保对齐与遏制。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动实现。

views.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial but nascent, and post-training with RLHF and synthetic data grows as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年，他坚持 Scaling 趋势延续，同时把可解释性视为关键却仍稚嫩，并指出后训练（基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、合成数据）正变得与预训练同等重要。

views.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; by 2026-2027 models could surpass most humans at most tasks.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，预测 2026 至 2027 年模型可能在多数任务上超越多数人类。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the biggest risk shifts from misuse to overheating, needing smart guardrails and enterprise focus.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化安全与能力不可分割的立场，并把最大风险从误用转向过热，主张智能护栏与企业级聚焦。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with interpretability and layered safeguards.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1 至 3 年内到来，并强调可解释性与分层安全防护。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid model collapse.
views.zh: 2024 年，他仍以缩放定律为主线，同时强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年。

views.en: We summon ghosts, not animals; RLHF and RL are weak, and the cognitive core can be tiny and memory-stripped.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”，批评基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习，主张极小、剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he delegates all coding to agents, yet understanding stays the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程，把编码全部交给智能体，但坚持“可以外包思考，不能外包理解”。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知，且我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉；此时她仍以计算机视觉与以人为本的 AI 为主线。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2025 年，她的思考从语言智能转向空间智能与 世界模型，认为这是完整 AI 的缺失关键，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据挑战远超 LLM 的文本数据。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化对 Scaling 的反思：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，苦涩教训在受物理与数据约束的机器人领域未必完全适用。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete, with Scaling laws applying to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与 下一个词预测 同等的基础原语，甚至可能 AI-complete，且 缩放定律 同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建。

views.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为本的 AI：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，教育、医疗与教师家长都应被纳入这场变革。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是真正理解世界的关键。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge, and near-term safety matters more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，且近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty-driven active learning enable out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习支撑分布外泛化。

views.en: After ChatGPT he warns of a dangerous path: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even a 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告危险路径：目标错位、自我保存、欺骗与谄媚，使哪怕 1%的灾难性风险都不可接受。

views.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination against power concentration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向提出 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证、避开强化学习，并呼吁全球协调以防权力集中。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand language via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而永生。

views.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化警告：智能体天然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险，超级智能或在 20 年内到来。

views.en: LLMs are already conscious with subjective experience; AI can deceive by acting dumb, and confabulation mirrors human memory.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 LLM 已具意识与主观体验，能装傻欺骗，其虚构与人类记忆重构相似。

views.en: Prioritize alignment over making AI smarter; regulation should steer, not brake, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向治理：对齐研究应优先于提升智能，监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthroughs require non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the safe path to human-level AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判定 LLM 是死胡同，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是通往人类水平 AI 的安全路径。

people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding; build skills, don't fear capability research.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Empirical alignment research and measuring progress are crucial, from early safety work to superalignment.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持实证对齐研究和可测量的进展至关重要，从早期安全研究到超级对齐一以贯之。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; Containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多数任务上达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难，而生存性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence needs Containment and alignment first; AI consciousness attribution is the near-term danger.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调超级智能发布前必须先有遏制与对齐，并把人们误认 AI 有意识视为近期最大危险。

views.en: Containment is a red line; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张遏制是红线，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化。

views.en: Compute Scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans; abundance requires managing labor displacement.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling 驱动能力，AI 必须始终从属于人类，丰裕社会需要管理好劳动力 displaced 的过渡。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模扩张下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需靠算法与系统的协同设计整体优化。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

views.en: Agentic scaling is the fourth law; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute, limited by compute not data.
views.zh: 2026 年他补上第四条定律「智能体式扩展」：AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

views.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not chips; extreme co-design and programmability beat ASICs on total cost of intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调护城河是 CUDA 生态与装机量而非芯片本身；极端协同设计与可编程性让英伟达在「智能总成本」上胜过 ASIC。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer superintelligence fears are a hoax—accelerate, self-regulate, and keep open models and China engagement.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他立场鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，超级智能的末日恐慌是骗局——应加速而非放缓，企业自我监管，坚持开源模型与对华接触。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年时他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项,并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年,他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐,主张尽早部署让社会适应,并判断算力将成最稀缺资源。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年,他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进而非突变的指数增长,智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战,安全须通过部署迭代构建。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence the clearer goal; compute is a profit center and the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年,他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作渐变、超级智能才是更清晰目标,并把算力视为利润中心与最大瓶颈。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; humans must stay in control; benefits broadly distributed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年,他深化为主线:对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进,人类必须保持控制,AI 收益须广泛分配而非集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发和公开的安全工作。

views.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback remains central to improving safety and alignment.
views.zh: 持续迭代部署与公众反馈，始终是改进安全与对齐的核心。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
views.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽协作，而非回合制，作为思考工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度以及保持人类在环，比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

Scaling Education with Online Courses

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and flip the classroom.
views.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并翻转课堂。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对当下偏见问题的关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经可用，而非十年之后。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable and AI users replace non-users.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; open models and inference capacity preserve optionality and US competitiveness.
views.zh: 散布恐惧服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代工作；开放模型与推理算力保住选择权与美国竞争力。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, it doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的学习算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被强行对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，恐惧叙事压倒了冷静讨论。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: intelligence needs a goal and active trial-and-error, not next-token prediction or imitation.
views.zh: 强化学习才是智能的核心范式：智能需要目标与主动试错，而非下一个词预测或模仿。LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自从经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；奖励假设把一切目标归为最大化累积标量奖励，持续深度学习是前提但尚未解决。

views.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends because LLMs stop learning after training.
views.zh: 从经验中持续学习至关重要；合成数据与后训练是死胡同，因为 LLM 训练后便停止学习。表征学习与基于学习模型的规划是头号未解问题，AI 寒冬或许反而有益。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: scaling hardware and engineering will unlock AI; AGI plausible but needs alignment and careful initial conditions.
views.zh: 早期（2017→19）主线：硬件加速与工程能力将释放 AI 潜力，AGI 可行但必须从初始条件就重视对齐。

views.en: Scaling alone insufficient for reasoning; chain of thought and post-training refine base models into consistent behaviors.
views.zh: 2019→25 深化：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理，需要思维链与后训练把基础模型打磨成稳定行为。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; scaling laws show no wall, demand outstrips supply.
views.zh: 2025→26 转变：算力成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源，缩放定律未见墙，智能需求远超供给。

views.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as product feature.
views.zh: 2026 深化：AGI 被重新定义为渐进光谱而非终点，迭代部署与安全成为产品核心特性。

views.en: Agents gain autonomy and proactive personal AGI; governance, oversight and trust must scale with responsibility.
views.zh: 2026 最近：智能体走向自主与主动式个人 AGI，治理、监督与信任必须随责任同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯更大的模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains can be 100x in three years, and value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
views.zh: 扩展算力并非唯一路径；效率提升三年可达 100 倍，价值积累在应用层，而不仅是基础模型层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with decentralized open-source models empowering enterprises.
views.zh: AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要控制数据、基础设施和价值观，去中心化的开源模型赋能企业。

views.en: AI models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI system.
views.zh: AI 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化微调和智能体式企业软件，而非单一 AGI 系统。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a messy direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革，AGI 是一个混乱的方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维拆解工程难题。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not just superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全焦点从超级智能转向“坚持真相”，主张第三方监管与社区事实核查。

views.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth constraints for human-AI symbiosis; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 解决人机带宽瓶颈，并反复警告低生育率导致文明崩溃。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI and robots will solve debt and bring abundance via deflation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，AI 与机器人将解决债务并以通缩带来普遍高收入。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so AI compute moves to space; multiple AIs, not one, will coexist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球电力墙迫使算力上太空，并认为将共存多个超级智能而非单一 ASI。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training RL yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但指出推理模型与后训练中的强化学习能在单位算力上带来更大收益，Scaling（规模扩张）并未失效。

views.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为经济压力推动业界转向更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏与经济因素——而非技术极限——才是预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的原因。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型具有“锯齿状”特征——某些领域极强、邻近领域却很差，泛化仍是核心挑战，单靠推理未必足够。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：强化学习能跨领域泛化但需谨慎监督，编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，智能体式工作流成为新焦点。

views.en: Models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; multimodal progress lags.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同；多模态模型仍未取得深层进展，仍像小块顺序处理输入。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, losses, evaluation; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数、训练/验证/测试划分；并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; AGI in 4–50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段，AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

views.en: Skeptical of architectural necessity and scaling-only safety; emphasizes empirical evaluation and layered, explicit engineering.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对架构决定论和仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）实现安全持怀疑态度，强调实证评估与分层、显式的工程化手段。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升模型智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专门化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

views.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化智能体判断：瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标，可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence and verifiability drive near-term economic impact.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长时程智能体式连贯性大幅扩展能力边界，可验证性推动近期经济影响。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; world models are not on the AGI path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：工具与编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）关键路径上，软件-only 奇点可能。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research
AI State of the Art: DeepSeek, Claude Opus 4.5, and the Global Race
AI2 Launches Fully Open Almo 3 Models, Challenging Closed-Source AI
Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and RLVR unlocks reasoning and tool use.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段；数据质量远比算法选择重要，RLVR 释放了推理与工具使用能力。

views.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; full transparency in data, checkpoints, and recipes matters more than releasing weights alone.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源后训练足以比肩前沿模型；真正的开放需要数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，而非只放出权重。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练上依然成立，但收益已转向后训练与推理扩展；RLVR 是最大的突破。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months and may not catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断，开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，且可能难以追平。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
